=========================================================================
[operator-attested] LIVE RUN GREEN — both outstanding ACs are now MET.
=========================================================================

RUN: external-integration.yml, workflow_dispatch on main @ 2bad4499d
     https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30576261975
JOB: "jira DC harness smoke (real Jira Data Center, ephemeral)" -> SUCCESS
     (ubuntu-latest, native amd64; real Jira 8.17.1 DC built and booted by the
     J5 harness, torn down after)

VERBATIM RESULT:
    [jira-live-canary] collected=11 executed=11 skipped=0
    11 passed in 7.29s

Read the canary line, not just the green tick — that is the honesty check for this AC.
"executed=11 skipped=0" is what makes this evidence rather than a green no-op: it proves
every test RAN. The two prior runs of this same job were green while the 7 transport tests
silently skipped, which is precisely the failure this AC exists to rule out.

THE 11 TESTS THAT EXECUTED AND PASSED

test_harness_smoke.py (4 — J5's harness, raw REST, no rebar imports):
  * test_instance_is_a_server_deployment_at_the_pinned_version
  * test_issue_created_via_rest_v2_reads_back_with_the_same_fields
  * test_personal_access_token_authenticates_via_bearer
  * test_a_bogus_bearer_token_is_rejected

test_transport.py (7 — the REAL JiraDataCenterTransport on pycontribs/jira, PAT bearer auth,
against the live instance). AC(a) coverage:
  * test_create_get_update_transition_roundtrip — TicketTransport: create_issue, get_issue,
    update_issue, transition_issue_by_name; each raw-shape asserted and each postcondition
    confirmed on the server (transition verified against the destination status the server
    itself declares in `to.name`)
  * test_transition_to_an_unavailable_name_raises — a transition the workflow does not offer
    raises rather than silently no-oping
  * test_comment_and_search_shapes_match_the_shared_contract — SupportsComments + search,
    held to tests/_jira_shape_contract.py, the SAME contract holding the Cloud transport
  * test_probe_remote_classifies_a_deleted_issue_as_archived_or_moved — SupportsAbsenceProbe:
    a genuinely deleted issue classifies as ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, not "some error"
  * test_select_backend_resolves_after_importing_adapters — the self-registration import

AC(b) coverage (the NameIdentity wire J4 left dangling — previously ZERO tests of any kind):
  * test_name_identity_user_search_resolves_a_real_user_authoritatively — the live
    `search_users` lookup returns an AUTHORITATIVE identity for a real DC user, and drives
    NameIdentity end to end (resolved-but-mismatched emits the resolved username; matching
    remote identity returns the converged signal)
  * test_assigning_an_unknown_user_raises_backend_assignee_not_found — an unknown user
    surfaces as the vendor-neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError on the apply path, while the
    resolver itself reports (None, True, False) — authoritative-but-unmappable, which
    _resolve maps to desired-unassigned. Both halves asserted live, so the division of labour
    is now pinned by test rather than by assumption.

WHAT IT TOOK — three real defects, none of which code review would have caught, all of them
only visible once the tests actually ran:
 1. the DC job installed `.[dev]`, which does not imply `[jira-datacenter]` -> every transport
    test skipped while sibling smoke tests kept the job green and masked the all-skip canary;
 2. tests/external/live_jira_dc/ never put src/rebar/_engine on sys.path, so the whole module
    died at setup with ModuleNotFoundError -> it could not have passed in ANY environment;
 3. the roundtrip test asserted the resulting STATUS name equalled the TRANSITION name, which
    is false in Jira's classic workflow ("Start Progress" leads to "In Progress").
Landed as changes 1053 and 1055 (both LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1, first-pass, merged).
A guard added in 1053 makes defect (1) unrepeatable: harness reachable + extra absent is now a
LOUD FAILURE, not a skip.

Collateral invariant re-checked: no change under adapters/jira/acli*.

Both outstanding acceptance criteria are satisfied by this run. Proceeding to close.
